pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.61-$0.81 per click (median $0.71), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.
